done_when: forge close opens a blocked pull request as a draft and marks it ready for review once its review is clean and its checks are green

findings.body: The tests assert that blocked creation includes `--draft`, but never assert that a newly created PR with a clean review and green checks ends ready for review. The existing clean-creation case in `tests/test_close.py:523–526` checks success, title and body only. Removing `draft and` from `src/forge/close.py:182` would therefore leave these tests passing while every new clean PR remained a draft: promotion at lines 86–87 skips newly created PRs because `pr` is still `None`. Extend the clean-creation case to verify creation without `--draft`, or subsequent promotion, so this required outcome has regression coverage.
findings.title: Not done: a newly opened clean pull request is ready for review

why: A pull request whose review is still blocked looks mergeable on GitHub
